arabic text: Ai Karbala Hussain ke gham ko Na Bhulana\nWarna Tujhe bhi saara Bhula dega zaman
english translation text: O Karbala, do not forget the grief of Hussain,\notherwise the whole world will forget you

arabic text: )\nKhaymese nange paaon chali, kis tarha Zainab\nYe Baat alamdaar ko Hargiz na batan
english translation text: \nHow Zainab walked barefoot from the tents—\nnever tell the standard-bearer

arabic text: )\nIn ret ke urhte huwe zaraat se kehna\nAsgher ki yehi qabr hai, usko na mitana
english translation text: \nTell these flying grains of sand:\nthis is Asghar's grave; do not erase it

arabic text: )\nTujh ko kiya hai karbobala kisne muala\nYeh khoon hai rasool ka isko na chupana
english translation text: \nWho elevated you, O Karbala?\nThis is the Messenger's blood—do not conceal it

arabic text: )\nAy chaand sitaaro Ali Akbar ki shahadat\nSughra ko na rasool ke rowze pe sunana
english translation text: \nO moon and stars, do not tell Sughra\nat the Prophet's shrine about Ali Akbar's martyrdom

arabic text: )\nBaalon se munh chupate huwe jaati hai zainab\nAi tez hawa inko na chehre se hatana
english translation text: \nZainab walks hiding her face behind her hair;\nO strong wind, do not move it away from her face

arabic text: )\nAb jaati ho Zainab to ye ek baat bhi sunlo\nHaathon ke zakhm ghazi ko Hargiz na dikhana
english translation text: \nNow that Zainab is departing, hear this one request:\nnever show Ghazi the wounds upon her hands
